title: Asymptotic distribution of CM points on the reduction of the Drinfeld modular curve
summary: We study a distribution problem over global function fields. More precisely, we describe the asymptotic distribution of rank $2$ CM Drinfeld modules among the irreducible components of the analytic reduction of the Drinfeld modular curve. Our approach relies on the properties of the building map and the spectral decomposition of the adjacency operator on a quotient of the Bruhat-Tits tree.
